prior_importants.description: PR rewrites the landed text of accepted ADR 0161 in place, mid-bullet, instead of appending a dated amendment section or adding a new decision with `Amends:`.

findings.description: The comment at the `collects(capabilityContext, files)` call ("the context carries the target sha as `configSha`") restates the new `configSha` JSDoc in adapter.types.ts and the `configSha: targetSha` line where the context is built; it can be deleted without losing anything.

The `listed.find((side) => side.measurePath === repo)?.nested` assertion repeats the `for (const side of listed)` loop right below it, which already checks the main-checkout side; the `find` assertion can go.

process_issues.description: Dropped a simplicity nit at src/adapters/git-tree.client.ts:57-63 saying the half-pinned-context throw can't be reached from production. The author added it on purpose in commit 0d8df15 ("refuse a nested listing that pins one sha alone"), so it falls under declared scope. Skipped reviewers: context (no spec, protocol or infra surface), maintainability (not on the default roster), spec (no closing issue or spec source), workflow-safety (no .github/workflows change).
